save.ar:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
save.tr: “Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great.”

lines.say: Two phrases. Light on the tongue. Heavy on the Scale.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy in the balance, and beloved to the Most Merciful.
lines.cap: Light on the tongue. Heavy in the balance.

lines.say: Al-Bukhari and Ibn Kathir both connect it to this verse:
lines.cap: Al-Bukhari & Ibn Kathir link it to this verse

lines.say: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all.
lines.cap: “…so no soul will be treated unjustly at all.”

lines.say: On the way, in a queue, before you sleep: keep them on your tongue.
Save this, and send it to someone you love.
lines.cap: Save this & send it to someone you love 🤍

h1.ar:
كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ،
ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ،
حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ
h1.tr: “Two words are light on the tongue, weigh heavily in the balance, and are loved by the Most Merciful One.”

h2.ar:
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
h2.tr: “Glorified is Allah and praised is He, Glorified is Allah the Most Great.”

v1.ar:
وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا
v1.tr: “And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all.”
